name: underscore-extensionpack
description: Language support for Underscore: syntax highlighting, practical snippets, native API hovers, and compiler-backed diagnostics with explanatory Error Lens messages.

underscore.compilerPath.description: Absolute path to the Underscore compiler executable. Leave empty to search common compiler, build, bin, and workspace locations.

underscore.standardLibraryPath.description: Optional directory containing standard-library modules. Passed to the compiler in the UNDERSCORE_STDLIB environment variable.

underscore.enableLiveDiagnostics.description: Run the compiler in -check mode after edits and publish errors in the Problems panel.

underscore.enableInlineErrorLens.description: Show a concise inline diagnostic after the affected source line. Hover the message for detailed explanations and corrected examples.

underscore.diagnosticDelayMs.description: Debounce delay after editing before the compiler check starts, in milliseconds.

underscore.diagnosticTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time allowed for one compiler diagnostics process, in milliseconds.

underscore.inlineErrorLensMaxMessages.description: Maximum number of diagnostic summaries displayed inline on one line.

underscore.inlineErrorLensMaxLength.description: Maximum approximate character length of one inline Error Lens message.

underscore.maxDiagnosticOutputChars.description: Maximum combined compiler output retained during a diagnostics run.
